title: Local phase lock stores switched binary edges
mechanism: Each directed edge integrates signed co-occurrence into an oscillator phase; phase cosine predicts the relation.
prediction: A phase-lock network will reduce early-after-switch Brier loss versus decayed correlation under recurring edge regimes.
falsifier: Across fixed seeds, early-after-switch Brier fails to beat decayed correlation, or judge L1 remains below 1.25x baseline.

author: odkrywca_dynamics

prediction: Damped phase locking beats decayed correlation on early-after-switch Brier and improves judge L1.
falsifier: Brier is not lower than EMA or judge L1 remains below 27.5.

author: odkrywca_dynamics
title: Predictive relations compete by prequential error
mechanism: Conditional source-target predictors share a normalized target weight; local squared prediction error reallocates that share, so stale relations lose influence without a prune threshold.
prediction: After a causal regime switch, early-window Brier falls below decayed pairwise correlation while the judge L1 remains above 27.5.
falsifier: No Brier improvement over EMA or judge L1 below 27.5 after three candidate turns
